name: Horns Twist
idea: From Horns, the dribbler heads for one screen, then the other big screens from the other side, and the dribbler twists back the other way.
why: The first screen makes the defender lean one way. Then a second screen comes from the other side, so the defender has two screens to get through, one right after the other. When a helper steps up to stop the dribbler, the second screener rolls to the basket.
tryit: Dribbler: take two dribbles toward the first screen, then wait for the second screener and change direction hard. Second screener: set the screen, then roll to the hoop with your hand up.

frames.say: This is *Horns*: {4} and {5} at the elbows, {2} and {3} in the corners, and {1} has the ball.
{4} sets a screen on the left, and {1} dribbles that way. {X1} leans left to get around it.
*Twist:* {5} runs over and sets a second screen on {X1}'s other side.
{1} twists back the other way, around {5}. {X1} is stuck, so {X5} steps up to stop {1}. {4} pops out wide.
{X5} left {5}, so {5} rolls to the basket.
{1} bounce-passes to {5}, all alone by the hoop.
Layup! Two screens from two sides are too much for one defender.
